correctness.rationale: All claims are reconstructed on complex ell^p for 1<p<infinity and alpha p<1. Telescoping gives the exact weighted binomial and first-difference matrices. Binomial unimodality/Stirling give mass and first-difference l1/linfinity norms; interpolation gives lp-prime row bounds. Splitting output at sqrt(n), applying Young/Hölder and summing i^(-alpha p) proves both upper rates. Uniform binomial local CLT and a fixed standardized positive-side rectangle produce constant-sign lower witnesses with matching exponents. The nonpowerbound, positivity, p-ACB and tangent disk statements follow independently. The standalone finite checker passes, but is not used to infer any infinite result.

value.rationale: The quantitative sharp two-sided exponent for every reflexive p>1 distinguishes polynomially growing powers from polynomially coalescing consecutive powers in a positive nonpowerbounded p-ACB family with tangential spectrum. This is a motivated test class for Arnold Question 8.2 rather than a mere restatement of Cesàro boundedness; the lower witnesses prove that the rate cannot be improved for the family. It extends the previously analyzed ell^1 regime to reflexive reflexive spaces and includes a sharp rate for p=2.
